function @headingDeviation() : number
	
	// Normalize the correction to the range [-180, 180]
	if ($corr > 180) 
		$corr -= 360;
	else
		if ($corr < -180) 
			$corr += 360;
	return $corr;

include "Bionic.main.xc"
include "screen.xc"


init
	$auth = if($auth == 0, 7,$auth)

update
	if(input_number(3,1) || input_number(3,2) ) ;manual input, reset heading to avoid ship trying to move back
		$heading = $currentheading
		

	$corr = $heading - $currentheading
	
	
	var $speed = input_number(4,0);

	;When
	var $maxturn = 200;
	if($speed > -1)
		var $direction = input_number(3,5)
		if($direction < -0.01 )
			if($heading < 1)
				$heading += 360
			if($corr > -$maxturn)
				$heading -= min(1, abs($corr + $maxturn))
		else 
			if($direction > 0.01)
				if($heading > 358)
					$heading -= 360;			
				if($corr < $maxturn)
					$heading += min(1, abs($maxturn - $corr))
